name: @battleplan/agents
description: Cursor cloud agent Lambda for launching runs and reading agent status.

scripts.test:local: vitest run --config ../vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --reporter=verbose agents && terraform -chdir=terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=terraform validate
scripts.test:agent: vitest run --config ../vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --reporter=junit --outputFile=../test-results/agents-agent.xml agents && terraform -chdir=terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=terraform validate
